# agy2dsh
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns two consumer AI subscriptions into ordinary DSH LLM providers:
**Google Antigravity** (`agy`, serving Gemini and Claude models) and **ChatGPT/Codex**. It registers
both with the host's `llm` service, refreshes their OAuth tokens itself, spreads requests across th

e
accounts you add, and reports the quota those subscriptions actually meter. It is for people who
a

lready pay for Antigravity or ChatGPT and would rather spend that allowance from DSH Desktop than
bu

Antigravity or ChatGPT and would rather spend that allowance from DSH Desktop than
buy API credits.

Package `agy2dsh`, version 0.8.0, MIT. The settings namespace is still `dsh-subscriptions` and the
H

TTP routes stay under `/dsh-subscriptions/...`: deliberate, so an existing install keeps its
account
s, slots and preferences across the rename.
## Features

- **Two LLM providers.** `antigravity` models come from `fetchAvailableModels`, filtered to the
mete

red families (`claude-*`, `gemini-3.8-flash-{low,medium,high}`); `codex` rows carry the
reasoning le

vels and context window the catalog publishes; both fall back to a bundled catalog.
- **Self-refresh

ing credentials.** One refresh in flight per account, backoff retries, clock-skew
correction, and a

retry against a newer token re-read from the CLI store on a rejected refresh.
- **Accounts and rotat

ion.** Every account is a slot with its own credential ref
(`ANTIGRAVITY_OAUTH_1`, `CODEX_OAUTH_2`,

...), proxy, concurrency limit and label; round-robin,
least-used or sticky ordering, family-scoped

cooldowns after 429s, quarantine with a warm-up probe.
- **Quota in the UI and from the right source

.** A pill on the session header, a Subscription Hub
with per-window bars and reset countdowns, an o

ptional composer quota; Antigravity numbers come
from `agy` when the CLI is logged into the same acc

ount and from the Cloud Code HTTP summary
otherwise, Codex numbers from the ChatGPT usage endpoint.
- **Images, reset credits, operations.** `generate_image` draws pictures with the subscription's Goo

gle
image model and shows them in the conversation (see Image generation), Codex
accounts can serve

the host's image generation service (`subscriptionImages`), Codex reset credits can
be consumed behi

nd a confirmation step, and the plugin keeps request history, diagnostics, a
localhost-only dashboar
d and an optional encrypted vault (WebDAV/Gist/S3).
## Requirements
- **DSH Desktop** with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, `dsh-credentials`, `dsh-settings` and `dsh-host-webse

rver`
at `^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.2`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis ^4.0.1` and `schemastery

^3.18.4`.
No Node install of your own: the host half runs in DSH Desktop's runtime (the 2.x app decl

ares
`node ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`).
- **`agy` CLI**, for Antigravity only — "import from CLI" and the

CLI quota source. Looked up via
`DSH_AGY_PATH`, `AGY_PATH`, then `%LOCALAPPDATA%\agy\bin\agy.exe`,

`%APPDATA%\agy\bin\agy(.exe)`,
`%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\agy\bin\agy.exe`.
- **Codex CLI is not r
equired**; if present, `~/.codex/auth.json` can be imported.
## Install

`agy2dsh` is a profile-sourced bundle: DSH Desktop composes the host from the active profile's
manif

est. Add it to that manifest (`package.json` in the profile directory, normally
[该节后续省略]
## How it works

- `lib/index.js` is the entry point (`export const name = 'agy2dsh'`,
`inject = ['llm', 'credentials

', 'webServer', 'settings']`). It builds the settings snapshot, creates the
account store and the ad

apter, registers the routes (`/dsh-subscriptions/{config,status,models,health,
check,history,diagnos

tics,accounts,oauth,import-local,import-token,vault,...}` — same-origin writes, a
loopback-only dash

board), and owns the background effects: a one-minute refresh heartbeat, a two-minute
quota loop, a

health probe, an hourly vault-sync check and a pending-OAuth sweep.
- `lib/accounts.js` is the crede

ntial and slot layer: blobs go through the credential service (secrets never
live in settings), and

per-account cooldown, quarantine, quota samples and health are kept here
(quarantines persist in `$D

SH_HOME/subscriptions/quarantines.json`). `lib/vendors/{antigravity,codex}.js`
implement the vendor

side (authorize, exchange, refresh, list models, usage, streaming),
`lib/code-assist.js` the Cloud C

ode contract, `lib/agy-usage.js` the CLI quota path.
- `lib/adapter.js` implements `LlmAdapter` (mod

el resolution, capability tags, image materialisation,
per-request account selection, retry and fail

over on 429, history), registered as
`ctx.llm.registerAdapter(['antigravity', 'codex'], adapter)` on

ce one provider has a credential.
- `lib/client.js` mounts the browser surfaces: the pill on `conver

sation.session.header.actions` (order 15),
the composer indicator on `conversation.input.right` (ord

er 5), the card and settings panel on
`plugins.item` / `plugins.bundle.config` / `plugins.row.config

`, and the `/login` and `/logout` slash
commands. It polls `/dsh-subscriptions/config` and renders t
he Hub through a portal.
## Security and privacy
- **Credentials stay in the DSH credential store**, written under `<PROVIDER>_OAUTH_<index>`. Settin

gs hold
only slot metadata; secret fields are redacted in `GET /dsh-subscriptions/config` and restor

ed from the
stored value before a write, so the browser never receives them. With `masterKey` (or
`D
SH_SUBSCRIPTIONS_MASTER_KEY`) blobs are encrypted before storage, and an encrypted blob without its

key
is refused rather than silently broken.
- **Quota data does not leave the machine.** It is read

from Google Cloud Code and `chatgpt.com` with the
account's own token and kept locally with the requ

est history and quarantine state. There is no
telemetry or analytics upload; `/dsh-subscriptions/tel

emetry` only summarises the local history.
- **Outbound traffic is what you enable.** Alerts POST to

`webhookUrl` if you set one, vault sync uploads
an encrypted archive to your backend, `proxyUrl` se

nds that account's traffic through your proxy, and
`/dsh-subscriptions/update` asks the npm registry

for the latest version if called. Config writes and
account actions are same-origin only; the dashb
oard and its history are loopback-only.
